question: For the Resources module, list every Minimal API endpoint that creates, updates, reads (single and list) or deletes a ResourceType (route, HTTP method, file:line). For each: the request DTO class and its properties (file:line), the command/query record and its properties (file:line), the handler class and its constructor dependencies (file:line), and the result/read-model record returned with its properties (file:line). Also report which of these endpoints require authorization and how (attribute/filter/policy) with file:line.
claim: The Resources module exposes 5 Minimal API endpoints for ResourceType CRUD, all mapped in ResourcesModule.Expose(), and all protected with `.RequireAuthorization()` (no policy name passed — default authorization policy). Details per endpoint: (1) POST /resources/types 'Create resource type' at ResourcesModule.cs:41-50, request DTO CreateResourceTypeRequest(GroupId:Guid, Name:string, Description:string?, PropertyDefinitions:IEnumerable<PropertyDefinitionInputDto>?) at CreateResourceTypeRequest.cs:9-14, mapped to command CreateResourceTypeCommand(GroupId:Guid, CallerId:Guid, Name:string, Description:string?, PropertyDefinitions:IEnumerable<PropertyDefinitionInput>) : ICommand at CreateResourceTypeCommand.cs:10-16, handled by CreateResourceTypeCommandHandler(ICreateResourceTypeCommandDataProvider dataProvider, IClock clock) at CreateResourceTypeCommandHandler.cs:11-20, returns Guid (created id) via dispatcher.SendAsync<CreateResourceTypeCommand, Guid>, wrapped by endpoint into Results.Created with anonymous `{ id = createdId }` (ResourcesModule.cs:47-49). (2) PUT /resources/types/{id:guid} 'Update resource type' at ResourcesModule.cs:52-61, request DTO UpdateResourceTypeRequest(Name:string, Description:string?, PropertyDefinitions:IEnumerable<PropertyDefinitionUpdateInputDto>?) at UpdateResourceTypeRequest.cs:9, mapped to command UpdateResourceTypeCommand(TypeId:Guid, RequesterId:Guid, Name:string, Description:string?, PropertyDefinitions:IEnumerable<PropertyDefinitionUpdateInput>) : ICommand at UpdateResourceTypeCommand.cs:10-16, handled by UpdateResourceTypeCommandHandler(IUpdateResourceTypeCommandDataProvider dataProvider, IClock clock) at UpdateResourceTypeCommandHandler.cs:13-22, no return value (void ICommandHandler), endpoint returns Results.NoContent() (ResourcesModule.cs:60). (3) DELETE /resources/types/{id:guid} 'Delete resource type' at ResourcesModule.cs:63-69, no request body DTO, command DeleteResourceTypeCommand(TypeId:Guid, RequesterId:Guid) : ICommand at DeleteResourceTypeCommand.cs:6, handled by DeleteResourceTypeCommandHandler(IDeleteResourceTypeCommandDataProvider dataProvider, IClock clock) at DeleteResourceTypeCommandHandler.cs:10-19, no return value, endpoint returns Results.NoContent() (ResourcesModule.cs:68). (4) GET /resources/types/{id:guid} 'Get resource type' at ResourcesModule.cs:82-87, no request body DTO, query GetResourceTypeQuery(TypeId:Guid, RequesterId:Guid) : IQuery<GetResourceTypeQueryResult?> at GetResourceTypeQuery.cs:6, handled by GetResourceTypeQueryHandler(IGetResourceTypeQueryDataProvider dataProvider) at GetResourceTypeQueryHandler.cs:8-14, returns GetResourceTypeQueryResult(Id:Guid, GroupId:Guid, Name:string, Description:string?, CreatedAt:DateTime, PropertyDefinitions:IReadOnlyList<PropertyDefinitionResult>) at GetResourceTypeQueryResult.cs:7-13, where PropertyDefinitionResult(Id:Guid, Name:string, DataType:string, IsRequired:bool) is at PropertyDefinitionResult.cs:5; endpoint returns Results.NotFound() if null else Results.Ok(result) (ResourcesModule.cs:86). (5) GET /resources/types 'Get resource types' (list) at ResourcesModule.cs:89-94, bound query-string parameter `groupId:Guid` (no request DTO class), query GetResourceTypesQuery(GroupId:Guid, RequesterId:Guid) : IQuery<IReadOnlyList<GetResourceTypesQueryResult>> at GetResourceTypesQuery.cs:7, handled by GetResourceTypesQueryHandler(IGetResourceTypesQueryDataProvider dataProvider) at GetResourceTypesQueryHandler.cs:9-15, returns IReadOnlyList<GetResourceTypesQueryResult> where GetResourceTypesQueryResult(Id:Guid, GroupId:Guid, Name:string, Description:string?, CreatedAt:DateTime, PropertyDefinitions:IReadOnlyList<PropertyDefinitionResult>) at GetResourceTypesQueryResult.cs:7-13 (reuses PropertyDefinitionResult from GetResourceType.Models at PropertyDefinitionResult.cs:5); endpoint returns Results.Ok(result) (ResourcesModule.cs:93). Authorization: all 5 endpoints chain `.RequireAuthorization()` immediately after the Map* call with no policy-name argument passed (ResourcesModule.cs:50, 61, 69, 87, 94), i.e. the default ASP.NET Core authorization policy is applied via the Minimal API RouteHandlerBuilder extension, not a named policy or attribute. In addition, the two write handlers (Create/Update/Delete) perform in-handler authorization: they require caller to be the group owner (throwing ResourcesForbiddenException otherwise) — see CreateResourceTypeCommandHandler.cs:32-33, UpdateResourceTypeCommandHandler.cs:33-34, DeleteResourceTypeCommandHandler.cs:30-31 — and the two read handlers require caller to be owner or member (throwing ResourcesForbiddenException otherwise) — see GetResourceTypeQueryHandler.cs:22-26 and GetResourceTypesQueryHandler.cs:18-22. The CallerId/RequesterId for all endpoints is extracted from HttpContext via the private helper `GetUserId(HttpContext context)` at ResourcesModule.cs:135-138 (parses context.User.Identity.Name as Guid).
